title: Classic American Pecan Pie
description: A rich and nutty dessert made with pecans, sugar, eggs, and melted butter. This classic American pie is a staple of the holiday season.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pecans, light brown sugar, granulated sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and melted butter.
Add the vanilla extract to the egg mixture and whisk to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the pecan mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the filling into the pie crust.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
